title: Colorimetric nanozyme sensing array based on the interface interaction of platinum nanoparticles for discriminating structurally similar triazine pesticides in water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,3370-3378
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00182J, Paper
Bingqian Jing, Yuanyuan Li, Xiaofeng Liu, Zihang Zeng, Zan Long, Bingni Jia, Bo Feng, Peng Zhang, Taiping Qing
A colorimetric nanozyme sensing array was developed for the identification of structurally similar triazine pesticides by using three types of Pt NPs functionalized with different ligands.
